title: IDBI Bank employee unions strike on Dec 3

ai.summary: IDBI Bank employee unions announced a one-day nationwide strike on December 3 to protest the proposed sale of the bank to Canadian firm Fairfax Financial Holdings, demanding the government and LIC halt the sale.

facts.claim: IDBI Bank employee unions have called a one-day nationwide strike on December 3
